checks.detail: Production requires an HTTPS origin and Secure session cookies.
TLS terminates at the reverse proxy: set DATAFORGE_TRUSTED_PROXIES to its exact address so per-client sign-in throttles do not collapse into one shared bucket.
Deployment templates and process limits target Linux.
SQLite >=3.39 is required for RIGHT/FULL joins.
Place the 32-byte application key outside the data directory with mode 0600.
Provision a separate valid backup key outside the data directory.
Configure an encrypted backup destination; independently verify its off-host replication.
Configure an HTTPS webhook or SMTP alert recipients.
Provide signed-off evidence references for browser, dependencies, recovery, security, acceptance, capacity, off-host backup, alerts and storage encryption.
